title: Optimal composition overhead for majority of local Boolean functions

standard_prerequisites.name: Elementary Shannon entropy/information inequalities and Boolean-function locality
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: All source-local query balancing, information-loss, Hamming-weight and partial-function lower bounds, free/buffer/control construction and bootstrap proof retained; complete original bibliography included.

core_obligations: Normalize how many inner local functions query each variable.
Quantify information lost through local Boolean outputs and establish the Hamming-weight lower bound.
Create free, buffer and control variable regions and reduce majority to a partial Hamming-weight computation.
Bootstrap the information bound to the exact general lower bound and advertised optimal logarithmic overhead.
difficulty_reason: Non-routine sharp information-loss bounds for local outputs are bootstrapped from a multi-output Hamming-weight lower bound to a single-output majority lower bound using free/buffer/control variables. The full main result and its parameter regimes form one item; support and branching-program implications are not extra tasks.
